title: Life Package (lifepackage/v1)
description: A local-first inheritance / 'in case I die' plan. A MAP of where things live and who should receive them — not a place to store raw secrets. IDs are arbitrary strings but must be unique within their array and referenced consistently.

id.description: Stable unique id for this plan (any string / UUID).

title.description: Plan title, e.g. 'Inheritance plan of Jane Doe'.

owner_id.description: id of the person who owns the plan (must exist in people).

default_language.description: One of languages — the primary language.

roles.description: Roles people can hold. If omitted, sensible defaults (owner, primary_heir, beneficiary, professional, friend) are added automatically.

people.description: Everyone relevant: the owner, heirs, helpers, professionals.

sensitive.description: Marks an entry that may hold something sensitive.

locations.description: Physical or logical places, nestable into a tree via parent_id (Country > City > Home > Safe).

parent_id.description: id of the parent location (omit for a top-level place).

access_person_ids.description: people who can physically access this place.

items.description: The things: accounts, wallets, keys, documents, devices, assets.

location_ids.description: where it lives (location ids). More than one = redundant copies.

container_ids.description: container ITEM ids this one is stored inside (e.g. a PIN inside a password manager) — the digital counterpart of location_ids.

depends_on_ids.description: other item ids this one needs (e.g. a PIN item).

guide_groups.description: Named groups for organising guides in the nav (e.g. 'General', 'Bitcoin').

guides.description: The human instructions: 'First steps', 'How to access my Bitcoin', etc. Content is Markdown per language.

group.description: guide_groups id this guide belongs to (omit for top level).

draft.description: If true, kept in the plan but EXCLUDED from the heir reader export.

content.description: Markdown body keyed by language code, e.g. { "en": "## Heading..." }. Reference other entities inline with [[id]] tokens; link a file tag with [#tag](#tag:slug).

references.description: Entities mentioned in the content (powers the cross-links). List the ids you used in [[id]] tokens.

audience_roles.description: role ids this guide is for (empty = everyone).

audience_person_ids.description: specific people this guide is for.

attachments.description: Files (scans, photos, PDFs). The AI usually leaves this empty — the user adds real files in the app afterwards. May still be referenced from items via attachment_ids.

path.description: Relative path inside the package, e.g. 'attachments/will.pdf'.

tags.description: lowercase slug tags for grouping/search, e.g. ['tax','2009'].
